payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results achieved by the proposed approach, including improved performance in fine-grained named entity classification and the ability to handle a large set of entity types using ELMo embeddings and Wikidata.

claims.text: The proposed model achieves improved performance in fine-grained named entity classification compared to existing systems without specific training on the dataset.
The model effectively utilizes ELMo embeddings and Wikidata to enhance entity representation and classification across 112 fine-grained entity types.
Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (FgNER) using the proposed approach can significantly improve performance in tasks like relation extraction and question answering.
